data.name: Raktim
data.gender_notes: Raktim is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Raktim is recorded with the meaning “Red”. Raktim is a Hindu name meaning “Red”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses. Note: this meaning has not been independently verified against a classical lexicon or primary source and is flagged for source verification.

in_sanskrit.name: रक्तिम्
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name of one who is like the color of the blood or the name of one who is as beautiful as the color of the blood.

in_hindi.name: रक्तिम
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name of one who has a red color or the name of one who is as beautiful as the color of blood.

in_tamil.name: ரக்திம்
in_tamil.meaning: அருட்புகழ் (அருட்பு) வாழ்வதுகள் என்ப்படும் விஷயம் என்பது இது வேண்டிய வாழ்வாளர்களுக்கு இது எண்ணம்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name of one who is as red as the color of blood or the name of one who is as beautiful as the color of blood for those who wish to be called so.

in_telugu.name: రక్టిమ్
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name of one who is as red as blood or the name of one who is as beautiful as blood for those who want to be addressed so.

in_marathi.name: Raktim
in_marathi.long_meaning: Raktim हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who has a red color.

in_bengali.name: Raktim
in_bengali.long_meaning: Raktim একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who has a red color.
